title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, a user who holds a role that can edit and run playbooks in Splunk SOAR could…
description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, users with roles that allow editing and running playbooks could exploit a vulnerability to execute non-read-only actions from a Safe Mode playbook, causing unauthorized state changes. This occurs because the system does not verify that the playbook run context in an action request matches the server-provided context.
